_readme: Bulgarian strings for bg/index.html, which tools/i18n.py generates from index.html (run by tools/build.py).
strings: English exactly as it stands in index.html (whitespace collapsed, entities as written) -> Bulgarian. Values may hold the same inline HTML (<em>, <b>, <span class="x">).
In index.html, data-i18n marks an element whose text is translated (an icon <svg> at its start or end is kept); data-i18n-attr="alt aria-label ..." names attributes to translate.
Change English text -> add the new English as a key here (the old key is then reported as unused). A missing key stops the build.
values: per-attribute replacements that are not translations (URLs, language codes, the switch's current marker).
keep: Latin-script words allowed on the Bulgarian page (names, brands, the program's loanwords); anything else in Latin script stops the build.
Keys starting with // are section labels and are ignored.
